default.console_spawnResident_tooltip:
spawnResident [str charaID,charaID,...] [str factionID] [optional str homeTemplateID | memberTypeID]
Generates one character per listed ID (CharaTemplateGenerator or base character ID, comma-separated, no spaces) and gives them a home in factionID.
Residential district (jp_district_apartment, jp_district_houses, jp_district_luxury_apartment, jp_district_budget_apartment): one new household home - first = family leader, others family members, a private room each, placed at the home's front door. Optional 3rd argument forces a home template.
Other faction (e.g. jp_hotel_business): each becomes a permanent resident with a free private room; optional 3rd argument = member type (default membertype_family_member; a hotel guest type uses its room prefix).
Nothing is generated if the district is full, no template has a bedroom per character, or rooms are missing - the reason goes to the log.
e.g. spawnResident jp_generic_adult_male,jp_generic_adult_female jp_district_apartment

default.console_regenBody_tooltip:
regenBody
Require current Target
Repair: discards the target's body and builds it again from the current character template (body traits, organs, womb, height/weight). Use after fixing a template, e.g. a missing penis size.
Discarded: organ contents, pregnancy and labor, reproduction cycle (restarted), body traces, in-game body trait changes.
Kept: organ first/last experience records (same organ), hairstyle. Equipped items come off and are put back on where the new body has a slot; the rest stays in the inventory.
Refused while the target is in a sex act or a birth job. Result goes to the debug log

default.console_collectActorTags_tooltip:
collectActorTags [optional string actionTag ...]
require target
Collects the image-generation prompt tags (LLMUtils.CollectActorTags) the game would gather for the current target and prints them into the debug log: prompt profile rules (hair/eye color, hairstyle, body type, skin color...), visible organs, the promptTags of every visible equipped item. Every extra word is passed as an action tag for the rules (e.g. collectActorTags sex unsafe spread_pussy); the tag combat also adds the promptTags of weapons carried in the inventory. Useful for checking which danbooru-style tags a character contributes to image generation
default.console_collectSceneTags_tooltip:
collectSceneTags [optional self]
require target (self = the player)
Scene image prompt of what the actor is doing (its current job + interaction job): prints the collected tags (actors with short tags, interactions, counts, scene tags after the derived tags), the applied rules, every prompt section and the flat prompt. Rules: prompt_* sections of Mods/Assetpacks/Image_Generation_Config.json, re-read and re-rolled on every call
default.console_generateSceneImage_tooltip:
generateSceneImage [optional self]
require target (self = the player)
Builds the scene prompt and sends it to ComfyUI (http://127.0.0.1:8188) using Mods/Assetpacks/ComfyUI.json. Replaces $composition$ $scene$ $location$ $actions$ $actors$ $mainActors$ $secondaryActors$ $actors_complex$ $actors_simple$ $prompt$ $seed$ $wd14_threshold$ $wd14_character_threshold$ $exclude_tags$. Main = the target; secondary = everyone else; complex = actors with more than 10 full prompt tags, excluding the short tag (list). Simple includes every actor, including the main actor and POV player: full prompt at 10 tags or fewer, otherwise shortPrompt (short tag, skin color, body shape, always-visible body tags). Entries are concatenated in actor order with duplicates kept. Downloads the MisteraOutput batch (else the first image output) to Mods/Assetpacks/_generated/temp_N.ext. Classifies each image for the main actor using scene data and optional WD14TaggerScoredImage scores from the same workflow; missing tags use scene data only. Copies classified images and JSON sidecars into _generated/<portrait template ID>/<category>/ and registers them for lazy portrait refresh without restarting. Skipped images stay in temp output; temp.json and the log include tag records, final paths, and skip reasons. One request at a time; generated assets respect safe mode and the _generated pack toggle

default.console_genFaction_tooltip:
genFaction [str generatorID] [str mode: own|district|existing] [str loc1] [optional str loc2] [optional str worldID]
Debug: runs a registered FactionGenerator template (Index_MapPlan.factionGenerator) to create a household, its characters, room groups, relationships, experience plug bindings, and temp-home/work/activity memberships.
Modes:
- own: instantiates the generator's homeTemplateID as <template>_gen_NNN and links its mainExit room to loc1 (attachFactionID) / loc2 (attachRoomID).
- district: creates a residence in loc1 (districtID or "auto" using homeScope); optional loc2 restricts the homeTemplateID.
- existing: places the household in existing faction loc1 as memberTypeID loc2 (hotel guest types use CheckIntoHotel).
Optional worldID overrides the resolved world. Nothing is created if validation fails.
e.g. genFaction household_jp_couple_generic district auto
